places.name: Shaniwar Wada
places.description: Historical fortification built in 1732, seat of the Peshwas of the Maratha Empire.
places.safetyTip: Well-lit tourist hub during daytime. Watch out for heavy traffic near entry gate.

places.name: Aga Khan Palace
places.description: Majestic palace built in 1892, closely associated with Mahatma Gandhi and Indian independence history.
places.safetyTip: Peaceful spacious grounds with high security. Ideal for families and solo travelers.
places.address: Nagar Road, Kalyani Nagar / Viman Nagar, Pune

places.name: Sinhagad Fort
places.description: Ancient hill fortress famous for the Battle of Sinhagad with panoramic mountain views.
places.safetyTip: Beware of steep rocky paths and monsoon slippery steps. Avoid late night isolated climbs.

places.name: Pataleshwar Cave Temple
places.description: 8th-century rock-cut cave temple dedicated to Lord Shiva carved out of basalt rock.
places.safetyTip: Free entry and calm premises. Mind your head on low cave ceilings.

places.name: Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum
places.description: Fascinating collection of over 20,000 rare Indian artifacts, instruments, and sculptures.
places.safetyTip: Located in a busy old-city lane; park vehicle at designated municipal spots.

places.name: Lal Mahal
places.description: Red brick palace where Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj spent his childhood.
places.safetyTip: Located near Shaniwar Wada; busy pedestrian market area nearby.

places.name: Osho Teerth Park
places.description: Tranquil 12-acre Zen garden and stream park in Koregaon Park created from reclaimed land.
places.safetyTip: Serene environment with security guards. Morning hours are best for calm walks.

places.name: Bund Garden (Mahatma Gandhi Udyan)
places.description: Popular public park by the Mula-Mutha river with boating facilities and walking trails.
places.safetyTip: Family friendly by day; avoid dark riverbanks late at night.
places.address: Sangamvadi, Near Dhole Patil Road, Pune

places.name: Saras Baug
places.description: Scenic park surrounding Talyatla Ganpati temple built in 1784 by Peshwa Madhavrao.
places.safetyTip: Great evening walk spot. Avoid unlit tree clusters after 9 PM.

places.name: Chhatrapati Sambhaji Garden
places.description: Lush city garden on JM Road featuring flower displays, aquarium, and children play zone.
places.safetyTip: Safe and vibrant family spot located right on busy JM Road.

places.name: Pu La Deshpande Garden
places.description: Japanese Okayama Friendship Garden with bridges, streams, manicured lawns, and koi ponds.
places.safetyTip: Strict security and well maintained. Photography rules apply.

places.name: Rajiv Gandhi Zoological Park
places.description: Large zoo and snake park around Katraj Lake featuring tigers, leopards, and reptiles.
places.safetyTip: Extremely large campus; wear comfortable walking shoes and stay on paved paths.

places.name: Vetal Tekdi (Hill Point)
places.description: Highest hill point in Pune city limits popular for morning treks, bird watching, and sunsets.
places.safetyTip: Ideal during sunrise and sunset. Carry water and trek in groups after twilight.

places.name: Taljai Hills Reserve
places.description: Protected forest hill area with free roaming peacocks, jogging track, and panoramic views.
places.safetyTip: Peaceful early morning venue. Beware of monkey groups near food stalls.

places.name: Vaishali Restaurant
places.description: Iconic South Indian cafe & popular student hangout famous for Filter Coffee & Masala Dosa.
places.safetyTip: Extremely crowded during weekends; keep an eye on belongings while waiting outside.

places.name: Goodluck Cafe
places.description: Legendary Irani cafe operating since 1935, famous for Bun Maska, Chai, and Keema Pav.
places.safetyTip: Located at busy Goodluck Chowk junction; watch out for turning vehicles when crossing.

places.name: Kayani Bakery
places.description: World-renowned heritage bakery in Camp famous for Shrewsbury Biscuits & Mawa Cake.
places.safetyTip: Long queues outside during festival season. Cash/UPI ready, limited street parking.

places.name: Bedekar Misal
places.description: Authentic Puneri Misal joint operating for decades in the heart of old city.
places.safetyTip: Narrow heritage lanes; walking or two-wheeler is strongly recommended over cars.
places.address: Munjabacha Boll, Narayan Peth / Shivajinagar, Pune

places.name: Effingut Brewerkz
places.description: Vibrant craft brewery and pub known for artisanal craft beers, pub food, and live music.
places.safetyTip: Upmarket area with valet parking. Secure night-life spot with security personnel.

places.name: Sujata Mastani
places.description: Iconic dessert parlor serving rich Pune-special thick ice-cream milkshakes (Mastani).
places.safetyTip: Family friendly dessert hub. Safe, well lit street front.

places.name: George Restaurant
places.description: Classic heritage restaurant in Camp known for Biryani, Mughlai delicacies, and vintage ambiance.
places.safetyTip: Busy commercial district with active street lighting and pedestrian traffic.

places.name: Malaka Spice
places.description: Award-winning South-East Asian bistro serving authentic Thai, Vietnamese, and Malaysian dishes.
places.safetyTip: Valet parking available. Safe dining hub in Koregaon Park.

places.name: Durvankur Thali
places.description: Renowned traditional Maharashtrian unlimited thali restaurant with royal local dishes.
places.safetyTip: Peak lunch hour wait times. Safe central neighborhood.

places.name: Apache High Street Bistro
places.description: Modern gastropub located in Balewadi High Street known for craft cocktails and continental platters.
places.safetyTip: High-end corporate nightlife district with security guards and CCTV surveillance.

places.name: Kalyan Bhel
places.description: Famous street food brand serving crispy Bhel Puri, Sev Puri, and Matki Bhel in Kothrud.
places.safetyTip: Quick bite joint. Clean prep area and easy roadside parking.

places.name: Irani Cafe Viman Nagar
places.description: Vibrant retro Irani coffee house popular among students and IT professionals.
places.safetyTip: Safe young neighborhood near Symbiosis college campus.
places.address: Datta Mandir Chowk, Viman Nagar, Pune

places.name: The Ritz-Carlton Pune
places.description: Luxury 5-star hotel offering ultra-premium suites, rooftop lounges, and spa.
places.safetyTip: Top-tier 24/7 private security detail and guarded perimeter.

places.name: JW Marriott Hotel Pune
places.description: Premier luxury business and leisure hotel on Senapati Bapat Road with world-class dining.
places.safetyTip: Highly secure campus with round-the-clock surveillance and gated access.

places.name: Zostel Pune
places.description: Trendy budget backpacker hostel with vibrant communal spaces and dorms for travelers.
places.safetyTip: Locker facilities inside dorms. Vibrant neighborhood in Viman Nagar near airport.

places.name: Conrad Pune
places.description: Art-deco inspired luxury Hilton hotel in central Pune with opulent amenities.
places.safetyTip: State-of-the-art hotel security and safe central location.
places.address: Mangaldas Road, Sangamvadi / Koregaon Park, Pune

places.name: Backpacker Panda Pune
places.description: Affordable cozy stay option for solo travelers located in lush green Koregaon Park.
places.safetyTip: Peaceful residential neighborhood. Keycard access for guests.

places.name: The Westin Pune Koregaon Park
places.description: Riverfront 5-star hotel offering heavenly spa treatments, fine dining, and executive suites.
places.safetyTip: Gated access with 24-hour security patrols.

places.name: Hyatt Pune
places.description: Upscale hotel near Pune Airport featuring open-air dining, outdoor pool, and business suites.
places.safetyTip: Secure property with dedicated airport shuttle and valet service.

places.name: Seasons Apartment Hotel
places.description: Comfortable long-stay serviced apartments and suites in the heart of Aundh.
places.safetyTip: Gated residential enclave in Aundh with round-the-clock receptionist.

places.name: Radisson Blu Hotel Pune
places.description: Contemporary business hotel strategically located near Hadapsar and Kharadi IT Parks.
places.safetyTip: Monitored parking garage and secure electronic keycard access.

places.name: Oxford Golf Resort Stay
places.description: Scenic hilltop resort & 18-hole golf course nestled in the Bavdhan valley near Kothrud.
places.safetyTip: Private estate with controlled security entry checkpoints.

unsafeZones.name: Old City Narrow Alleyway (Low Light)
unsafeZones.reason: Dimly lit alleys after 10 PM. Exercise caution with valuables.

unsafeZones.name: Katraj Ghat Curve Hazard Zone
unsafeZones.reason: Sharp hairpin bends and high accident rate during rain/night.

trafficZones.name: Swargate Chowk Congestion
trafficZones.tip: Major bus junction. Use metro or alternate side road if possible.

trafficZones.name: University Circle Construction Zone
trafficZones.tip: Ongoing flyover work causing lane merging bottlenecks.

trafficZones.name: Hadapsar Magarpatta Junction
trafficZones.tip: Heavy IT office commute flow between 5 PM and 8 PM.

neighborhoodInsights.name: Koregaon Park
neighborhoodInsights.summary: Safest and cleanest green residential zone in Pune, but high living and dining costs.

neighborhoodInsights.name: Viman Nagar
neighborhoodInsights.summary: Modern, highly accessible with great eateries, hostels, and strong night safety.

neighborhoodInsights.name: Aundh & Baner
neighborhoodInsights.summary: Well-planned suburban neighborhoods with premium dining and secure streets.

neighborhoodInsights.name: Kothrud
neighborhoodInsights.summary: Family-friendly, calm neighborhood with low crime rates and good budget options.

neighborhoodInsights.name: FC Road / Deccan
neighborhoodInsights.summary: Vibrant street food & shopping hub. High safety during daylight, busy traffic jams.

neighborhoodInsights.name: Hadapsar / Magarpatta
neighborhoodInsights.summary: Sprawling IT corridor; safe inside townships, heavy traffic bottlenecks on main highway.

neighborhoodInsights.name: Swargate & Old City
neighborhoodInsights.summary: Rich in history and extremely budget-friendly, but congested streets and lower cleanliness.
